name: with no records in the product, signed-out work joins A without a decision and the anon replica is rebound
with records in the product and no decision, the sign-in is incomplete: holds are released and nothing else changes
an incomplete sign-in records pendingSignIn; the sign-in that completes clears it
the signed-out decision answered add rebinds the anon replica under A
the signed-out decision answered discard ends the product's entries discarded, deletes its device rows and starts a new bound replica
a dormant replica of A is rebound; the anon entries, notices and new device rows move after its own
a dormant replica of another account is left dormant
an anon replica without entries stays anon beside a new bound replica
anonCount counts, by type, the distinct records the product's entries create or change
